name: Differential protection
summary: A function comparing documented electrical quantities across a protection zone.
description: Differential protection compares quantities associated with the boundaries of a protection zone according to the selected implementation. Equipment and application suffixes can distinguish transformer, busbar, line or other arrangements. The base number alone does not define the zone or measurements.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify the protected zone and each measurement boundary.
Read CT associations, polarity and any device-specific compensation from the protection documentation.
drawingChecklist: Identify the protected equipment or zone.
Link the relay application and trip destinations.
distinction: Transformer differential, busbar differential and other differential applications are not interchangeable merely because they share the base number 87.
